name: Lionville YMCA Camp (Camp Lionville)
description_short: YMCA day camp run by the Lionville Community YMCA at two Exton sites in 2026: Church Farm School and the Lionville Community YMCA. Campers ages 5 to 12 swim daily, play gaga and sports, do crafts and take field trips every other week; there are half day art, STEM and preschool camps, and teens 12 to 15 in Teen Trek go on field trips Tuesday to Friday.
refund_policy_summary: Cancel at least two weeks before the camp week for a refund of fees paid, less the non-refundable $35 a week deposit; no refunds or changes within two weeks of the start, or for illness.

sessions.name: Week 1: Jurassic Jungle (no camp Friday June 19)

notes: 2026 prices shown are the guest (non-member) weekly rates: traditional camp $449 (members $365); sports camps $449; Teen Trek $505 ($397); CIT $349 ($293); half day art and STEM camps $266 ($225) with optional Specialty Sidekick add on $217 ($185); Aquatic Adventure $483 ($410, at the YMCA); preschool Camp Discovery for ages 4 to 5, mornings, $225 ($183, at the YMCA). Week 1 is four days and prorated; a pre-week June 8 to 12 is also offered. Camp 9 to 4; Morning SPARK 7 to 9 is $25 a week; 4 to 6 pm is included. Lionville Community YMCA is at 100 Devon Drive, Exton.
